rubric_items.reason: Builds on the existing db, api and web modules and layering (repo/service/route); the job is an in-process timer with no new infrastructure, matching architecture#open-points.
Story map covers S-1 to S-7 with components and endpoints; guard, reschedule-to-SCHEDULED, list filter, badge and glossary (via A-11) serve every AC.
Every changed field has name, type, nullability, format and example; EP-3 to EP-6 mix a request precondition into the response status format and leave the rejection case implicit.
Most choices cited or decided by A-08..A-11 and C7 is Assumed with implement must confirm; CO-10 changes styles.css with no path and cites only StatusBadge, and the startup run is undecided.
Trade-offs for in-process timer, hourly cadence and slot release are explained; running the job once at startup has no reason given.
Clear and consistent overview, component list and story map; minor inconsistency in CO-12 module/change labels.

findings.text: CO-10 changes styles.css but gives no path and cites only StatusBadge.tsx#L6, a sibling file; the stylesheet's existence and location are unproven and it is not listed as Assumed with implement must confirm.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the full path (web/src/styles.css) and cite a line that proves it exists, or list CO-10 under Assumed with implement must confirm.

findings.text: C11 cites context/generated/db-schema.json, which is not among the design's declared inputs, so its sha is not pinned.
findings.suggested_fix: Add context/generated/db-schema.json with its sha256 to inputs.

findings.text: CO-12 is labelled change existing on module sample-system:. although the work is a new glossary entry in the companion context pack, outside the product repo, as A-11 decided.

findings.text: EP-3 to EP-6 put the request precondition into the response status field's format, and leave the rejection for other statuses implicit, so ACs cannot test the error case exactly.

cites.quote: request accepted when the current status is SCHEDULED or STALE; response status COMPLETED

findings.suggested_fix: Give the response status format as the fixed value and state the precondition and its existing 409 response separately.

findings.text: The job runs once at startup as well as hourly; A-08 only decided the cadence and the design gives no reason for the startup run.

cites.quote: runs once at startup and every hour (C12)

findings.suggested_fix: Add a trade-off line explaining the startup run (catch-up after a restart).
